detect_language.description: Find out which language a text is written in, with an English translation, for example to send each customer's message to the right team or to reply in their language. Only the opening of the text, about 500 letters, is sent. It needs a few words of real text: a lone word or a number can be misread. No account required.

mock_response.english_translation: Where is my order? I've been waiting for two weeks.
mock_response.text_checked: Wo ist meine Bestellung? Ich warte seit zwei Wochen.

find_translation_matches.description: See every translation MyMemory holds for a sentence: people's translations of it and of similar sentences, and its machine translation, each with how closely it matches and who added it. Use it to pick a wording yourself or to check how sure a translation is. One sentence of up to about 500 letters. No account required.

translate_text.description: Translate a text into another language, such as a customer's message, a support reply or a product name. Leave 'Translate from' on Detect automatically and MyMemory works out the language. You get the translation, whether a person or a machine made it, and how closely it matches. Up to 5,000 characters: MyMemory takes about 500 letters at a time, so longer text is split at its sentences, translated piece by piece and put back together. No account required.

translate_texts.description: Translate up to 50 texts into one language in one step, such as the answers to a form or a column of a spreadsheet, and get them back in the same order. With Detect automatically, each text's language is worked out on its own, so answers written in different languages all come back in one. Blank items stay blank, and a text that appears twice is sent once. Up to 5,000 characters in all. No account required.

description: Translate short texts, such as customer messages, support replies, product names and form answers, between more than 100 languages. MyMemory answers from its large shared memory of people's translations and falls back on machine translation. Translate one text, a list of texts, or one text into several languages at once, see every translation it holds for a sentence, and detect which language a text is in. No account needed.
